caption: The drawing depicts a dagger and its sheath shown from different angles on a plain, off-white background. The dagger, positioned on the left, features a straight, pointed blade colored in grayish-blue tones. The hilt of the dagger is cylindrical with a light, metallic coloration, possibly silver or light gold, and has a subtle decorative pattern near the top including a golden or ochre colored shield shape. The guard is a simple horizontal bar with curled ends, depicted in a brownish-gold color. To the right of the dagger, there are two separate views of the sheath; the top view shows the mouth of the sheath with an oval raised design, while the full-length view of the sheath beneath it displays an ornate pattern with light blue, beige, and gray hues as well as additional decorative elements along the rim. The name “OSCAR BLUHM” is written in small, neat letters in the bottom right corner of the drawing. The composition is centered, with ample empty space around the objects.
title: Silver Dagger and Sheath
